name: @immunity-wars/look-prototype
description: Stage L2 of docs/LOOK_PLAN.md: the Clay play screen playing one recorded turn and one spread, drawn three ways (pictures on the page, pictures on a GPU canvas, the models drawn live), with the frame timer that measures them on the Samsung Galaxy S25. A measuring instrument, not app code: nothing in packages/ imports it.
comment:build: `build` is a no-op on purpose, as in tools/perf: the repository's `pnpm build` must not depend on a prototype. `build:web` makes the page that `preview` serves to the phone.
comment:dependencies: pixi.js and three are here and nowhere else (ruled 1 October 2026, docs/LOOK_PLAN.md section 12). Whichever way of drawing is ruled at the end of L2 moves into the app as its own decision; the others are removed with this package.
